FLASHCARD · EXTRA-CURRICULAR ACTIVITIES · AGES 3–12 YEARS

Journaling Flashcard for Kids

Ages 6+Read & write

Journaling club is the notebook club: one page a day for whatever matters — the best bite of lunch, the unfair moment, the dream that woke you. The card prints the club’s two skills — Reflect & Express — thinking back and writing it down. This card’s job: give the child a private place where the day can land.

← Horse RidingPrevious cardLego →Next card

Say it together

“Journaling club! This notebook is yours — spelling does not matter, truth does. Reflect & Express: writers write what the day was really like. What was today’s headline?”

Say it naturally, then wait. Whatever comes back — the word, the sound, a point, a giggle — is the right answer.

Try this

Three-lines-a-day rule: today I saw / today I felt / tomorrow I hope. Three lines takes two minutes, and two minutes keeps the habit alive for months.

Quick parent note

Captain’s logs, flight logs, diaries kept by explorers — most of history’s best stories survived because somebody wrote small, honest notes daily.
